explanation.zh-CN: console.log 把值输出到控制台；let 声明可重新赋值的变量。
explanation.en: console.log writes a value to the console; let declares a reassignable variable.

explanation.zh-CN: typeof 返回类型的字符串名：number、string、boolean；注意 typeof null 会返回 "object"。
explanation.en: typeof returns a type name string: number, string, boolean; note that typeof null returns "object".

explanation.zh-CN: 反引号包围的模板字符串用 ${...} 插入变量，比字符串拼接更清晰。
explanation.en: A backtick template literal inserts variables with ${...}, clearer than string concatenation.

note.zh-CN: 反引号开始模板字符串

explanation.zh-CN: 1 == "1" 会先把字符串转成数字，结果为 true；1 === "1" 类型不同，结果为 false。
explanation.en: 1 == "1" coerces the string to a number and gives true; 1 === "1" has different types and gives false.

note.en: === requires the same type and value

explanation.zh-CN: 85 >= 60 为真，执行 if 分支输出 pass；else 分支被跳过。
explanation.en: 85 >= 60 is true, so the if branch prints pass and the else branch is skipped.

note.zh-CN: if 后的条件决定分支
note.en: The condition after if decides the branch
else runs when the condition is false

explanation.zh-CN: for (初始化; 条件; 更新) 三段控制循环：i 从 1 开始，每次 +1，直到超过 3。
explanation.en: for (init; condition; update) has three parts: i starts at 1, increments by 1, and stops when it exceeds 3.

note.zh-CN: i++ 在每轮结束后自增

explanation.zh-CN: function 声明一个具名函数，return 把结果交回调用处；add(2, 3) 返回 5。
explanation.en: function declares a named function and return hands the result back; add(2, 3) returns 5.

explanation.zh-CN: 箭头函数用 (参数) => 表达式；单参数可省略括号，单表达式可省略 return。
explanation.en: Arrow functions use (params) => expression; a single parameter may omit parentheses and a single expression may omit return.

note.en: A function value declared with const

explanation.zh-CN: makeCounter 返回的内部函数保留了 count 变量；每次调用 counter() 都让同一个 count 加 1，所以输出 1、2。
explanation.en: The inner function returned by makeCounter closes over count; each counter() call increments the same count, so it prints 1 then 2.

note.en: The variable captured by the closure

explanation.zh-CN: user.name 用点号访问，user["age"] 用方括号访问；两种写法等价。
explanation.en: user.name uses dot access and user["age"] uses bracket access; both are equivalent.

explanation.zh-CN: push 末尾追加，length 取长度，[1] 取第二项，join 用分隔符拼成字符串。
explanation.en: push appends, length counts, [1] reads the second item, and join builds a delimited string.

explanation.zh-CN: map 把每个元素乘 2，filter 保留偶数，reduce 从 0 开始累加得到 10；这些方法都不修改原数组。
explanation.en: map doubles each element, filter keeps evens, and reduce sums from 0 to 10; none of them mutate the original array.

note.zh-CN: map 用回调转换每个元素
note.en: map transforms each element via the callback

explanation.zh-CN: new Promise 在 10ms 后 resolve("done")；then 的回调在 Promise 完成后执行并输出结果。
explanation.en: new Promise resolves with "done" after 10ms; the then callback runs once the Promise settles and prints the value.

note.zh-CN: const 接收 Promise 对象
note.en: A Promise held in a const

explanation.zh-CN: await 等待 fetchValue() 返回的 Promise 完成，value 得到 42；async 函数内部才能使用 await。
explanation.en: await waits for the Promise from fetchValue() and value becomes 42; await is only allowed inside async functions.

note.en: A plain function returning a Promise

note.zh-CN: await 等待 Promise 结果
note.en: await waits for the Promise result

explanation.zh-CN: 合法 JSON 返回 true；非法 JSON 让 JSON.parse 抛出 SyntaxError，被 catch 捕获后输出错误名，函数返回 null。
explanation.en: Valid JSON returns true; invalid JSON makes JSON.parse throw SyntaxError, which catch handles by printing the name and returning null.

note.zh-CN: catch 捕获指定异常对象
note.en: catch receives the thrown error object

title.zh-CN: ES Module 的导出与导入

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（跨文件，静态检查）：math.js 用 export 命名导出 add，main.js 用 import 引入；模块有独立作用域。
explanation.en: Read-only (two files, statically checked): math.js exports add by name and main.js imports it; modules have their own scope.

note.zh-CN: import 引入其他模块的成员
note.en: import brings in a member from another module

explanation.zh-CN: 仅阅读（需要浏览器 DOM，静态检查）：querySelector 选中按钮，addEventListener 监听 click，回调里修改按钮文字。
explanation.en: Read-only (needs browser DOM, statically checked): querySelector selects the button, addEventListener listens for click, and the callback updates its text.

note.zh-CN: const 保存 DOM 元素引用
note.en: A const holds the DOM element reference

explanation.zh-CN: JSON.stringify 把对象转成文本，JSON.parse 再把文本变回对象，因此可以取出 count 属性。
explanation.en: JSON.stringify converts an object to text and JSON.parse turns it back, so the count property can be read again.

note.zh-CN: stringify 输出 JSON 文本
